No additional evidence.

## Analysis
RECOMMENDED: target Friday at Steamboat if the announced reopening proceeds with usable terrain. 14 inches during closure plus 6 inches before opening totals 20 inches of snowfall, not a measurement or promise of retained powder. Friday has a plausible weekday advantage; Saturday adds 12 inches and could be better if terrain releases slip. No crowd observation or terrain release schedule is confirmed. Lodging is an unverified $180 per-night estimate; total trip cost unknown.
Only list sources actually cited or retrieved, never suggested future checks. Keep illustrative budgets distinct from trip cost estimates. Preserve decisive conditions in both recommendation and summary; a possible reopening must not become a confirmed reopening in any field.
